video_title: Nyjer Morgan On Why The Milwaukee Brewers Keep Winning & His Brew Crew Memories

quotes.speaker: Tony Cartagena
quotes.summary_phrase: balancing analytics and traditional scouting in baseball team management
quotes.excerpt: If you met somewhere in the middle, you're going to have a pretty good team.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Cartagena
text_blocks.text: There are some teams that are 100% analytic-driven and there are some guys that are just like, no, I know how to evaluate athletes. When you look at, especially in baseball, of analytics, if you met somewhere in the middle, you're going to have a pretty good team. Probably like the Milwaukee Brewers.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Cartagena
text_blocks.text: Their manager is very much a baseball guy, but their front office are analytics guys and they meet and they make decisions.

text_blocks.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: But that's why they're so successful.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: the financial and professional realities of being a pro athlete
quotes.excerpt: It's the only place that somebody can be eligible to make millions of dollars.

text_blocks.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: The US is amazing. It's the only place that somebody can be eligible to make millions of dollars. Eligible, bro. To be a professional, to work. They have a home steady, they have gas bills and phone bills under their name, but they're not allowed to drink.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Cartagena
text_blocks.text: At 18, they can ship you off to fight, no beer.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: the disconnect between professional responsibility and legal age restrictions
quotes.excerpt: We've done a poor quality early of educating people.

text_blocks.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: That means we've done a poor quality early of educating people. Because if you did educate people early, you won't need to have somebody like old enough to understand like, no, I don't need to drink. He's professional, making millions of dollars, and cannot get in because we don't think you're responsible enough.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Cartagena
text_blocks.text: You can go to Canada, I think you can drink at 18. You go south in Alberta, you can go to Mexico and get it in, too.

quotes.speaker: Tony Cartagena
quotes.summary_phrase: Peyton Watson's experience with age restrictions in professional sports
quotes.excerpt: Nuggets win the title, they go to Vegas, they're walking into the club, bouncer owner at the front.
quotes.quote: Peyton Watson was just on the show. He was 18 or 19, played for the Nuggets when they won the title. They go to Vegas, they're walking into the club, whole team, they're rented it out. Bouncer owner at the front is like, yeah, we know you're not 21, you can't come in.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: the social dynamics of being a professional athlete and age restrictions
quotes.excerpt: My team wins the championship, I win a championship, but I'm not eligible to go and drink.
quotes.quote: My team wins the championship. I win a championship, but I'm not eligible to go and drink with my friends. And my friends came from Greece to watch me, but I go like, yeah, you guys can go in, I'm going to stay out. If they go in, we're not friends no more.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo's appreciation for Japan
quotes.excerpt: Japan is one of the greatest places of the planet.
quotes.quote: Japan is one of the greatest places of the planet. I've been to my life in four places trips that I've said to myself like, I want to go there every year.

quotes.speaker: Nyjer Morgan
quotes.summary_phrase: Nyjer Morgan's career in Japan with the Yokohama DeNA BayStars
quotes.excerpt: I was in Yokohama DeNA BayStars. Had a great season out there.
quotes.quote: I was in Yokohama DeNA BayStars. Had a great season out there. I thought I was going to finish my career out there. I was able to do my thing, I was able to actually be me.

quotes.speaker: Nyjer Morgan
quotes.summary_phrase: Nyjer Morgan on why he didn't finish his career in MLB
quotes.excerpt: In my eyes, I don't think I had the right manager or my agent.
quotes.quote: In my eyes, I don't think I had the right manager or my agent. That's why I fired like seven agents of mine. I couldn't get it done, baby. Don't forget, I do it on the field, you just do it in the boardroom.

quotes.speaker: Tony Cartagena
quotes.summary_phrase: the shift in how sports agents are credited for deals
quotes.excerpt: Instead of saying sources tell me, it's like deal was done by, there'll be like three or four agents.
quotes.quote: Have you noticed more and more guys in social and reporting, people want to say like, instead of saying sources tell me, it's like deal was done by, there'll be like three or four agents listed nowadays. It's not just Drew Rosenhaus anymore. It's not just Scott Boras. It's like multiple agents on some of these contracts.

quotes.speaker: Nyjer Morgan
quotes.summary_phrase: Nyjer Morgan's viral tweet about Albert Pujols
quotes.excerpt: I sent a tweet saying Albert couldn't see T-Plush with gloves in the ring!
quotes.quote: I remember I put out that tweet about Albert Pujols. That was on the back of the plane. I was doing my thing on the back of the plane, tweeted it out. I sent a tweet saying Albert couldn't see T-Plush with gloves in the ring!

quotes.speaker: Nyjer Morgan
quotes.summary_phrase: Nyjer Morgan's competitive rivalry with Chris Carpenter
quotes.excerpt: Chris Carpenter and I had some words. I have nothing but respect for Chris Carpenter.
quotes.quote: Chris Carpenter and I had some words. I have nothing but respect for Chris Carpenter because I think that everybody has a nemesis and he was my nemesis. We just had a really good competitive battle and he ended up striking me out.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo's perspective on the Miami Heat rivalry
quotes.excerpt: For the last 10 years, we would consider that like Miami's been one of the best teams.
quotes.quote: For the last 10 years, we would consider that like Miami's been one of the best teams. They took us out twice in the playoffs. Even the year we took them out the playoffs, that's the year we won. So that gave us a huge boost and we actually won the whole thing.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on the atmosphere of playing the Chicago Bulls
quotes.excerpt: Whenever we step in Chicago, the whole atmosphere would change.
quotes.quote: Whenever we step in Chicago, the whole atmosphere would change because I think this is from old days. I think this has to do with like when Michael Jordan was there. Not just us, because I could feel like people would talk about that.

quotes.speaker: Tony Cartagena
quotes.summary_phrase: why Chicago Bulls fans travel to Milwaukee games
quotes.excerpt: Chicago fans would come up to Milwaukee because hour and a half drive.
quotes.quote: It started off when Michael Jordan was there, too. Chicago fans would come up to Milwaukee because hour and a half drive. It's super quick and it was significantly cheaper to honestly do like a room, a night out, tickets to go to the United Center.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: how team rivalries affect fan perception
quotes.excerpt: Whenever we play another team, everybody's Milwaukee, and whenever we play Chicago, you would see like.
quotes.quote: Whenever we play another team, everybody's Milwaukee, and whenever we play Chicago, you would see like, also the same people. I was like, well, he was just with the green jersey. He was like, yeah man, but I'm on Chicago, bro. You know what I'm saying? Chicago. And you know, if you ask them, London will say obviously and Michael Jordan, but the second person that will say is Derrick Rose.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: cultural differences in sports fandom between Greece and the US
quotes.excerpt: In Greece and in Europe in general, you have this like the fan base.
quotes.quote: In Greece and in Europe in general, you have this like the fan base and the love like tears, like people cry, bro. Like this is that's why we call them clubs. The only time I've ever seen that was in Japan. People crying, yeah. And we don't say teams, we say clubs because it's like a brotherhood in a club like every every team.

quotes.quote: Here, it's straight entertainment. Could have their own reality TV show. Oh yeah. Not swear to God, I swear. Like after this is how crazy it is.

quotes.summary_phrase: the global appeal of sports fan experiences

quotes.quote: People don't understand about Greek league basketball or Euro basketball, the fan and the experience there. That's same in Japanese baseball. quotes.speaker: Nyjer Morgan
quotes.summary_phrase: Nyjer Morgan's prediction for the Milwaukee Brewers
quotes.excerpt: We have a chance to win the whole World Series... World Series or nothing!
quotes.quote: Man, go win it all. I've been telling you guys since the very very very beginning, we have a chance to win the whole World Series. I'm definitely coming up. I already got my man T spot on the car. So it's all good. So World Series are nothing. So let's go Brew Crew.
